items.title: Neovim have a ~$800k Bitcoin donation sitting untouched since 2023
items.description: I was looking at neovim's donation footer at the bottom of their site and saw a bitcoin donation address. Thought I'd check how much in donations they've gotten. And I saw this massive 10 Bitcoin donation from back in 2023 (worth $800,000 now...) From the activity history, neovim last sent bitcoin out of the address in 2019 so it's been max 7 years since they've definitely had access. Does anyone from the neovim project know about this? Seems like a pretty significant amount of funding to have sitting there. Hope it can come to good use as I use neovim daily. https://www.blockchain.com/explorer/addresses/btc/1Evu6wPrzjsjrNPdCYbHy3HT6ry2EzXFyQ Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49738879 Points: 167 # Comments: 60
